Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. The Bangladesh players stride out to the middle. Followed by Nahida Khan and Sidra Ameen who walk out to open for Pakistan. Jahanara Alam to start with the new ball. Here we go...
... The Run Chase ...

Now the target is a big one, Pakistan will have to bat really well. The wicket is offering a little bit of turn and Bangladesh are a good bowling side. They will back themselves to defend this. Do Pakistan have it in them to chase it down?

Fargana Hoque is in for a chat. She says, the wicket is a little slow and took her time to get into her rhythm. Mentions, Nigar Sultana is a brilliant batter. Adds they did well to built a solid foundation but they will make sure to improve their finishing in the upcoming games. Ends by saying she thinks a win for them is around the corner if they stick to their plans.

The bowling was quite poor from Pakistan! They leaked a lot of runs with the new ball. The likes of Nida Dar and Nashra Sandhu did manage to pull things back but the others could not continue the good work. There was always a bad ball here and there and that cost them. They though did bowl well right towards the end which did not allow Bangladesh to run away with the game but they will not be very pleased after electing to bowl.

End of an excellent batting display from Bangladesh and they will be very pleased with how things stand at the moment. The key for them was partnerships, except for the overs at the death, they just never lost wickets in a heap. It was the openers first who set the tone with a really good partnership. Then Akhter and Hoque continued the good work. However, the partnership between Fargana Hoque and Nigar Sultana is what took them on top. The two added close to 100 and that laid the foundation. Hoque was the pick of the batters. However, once she fell, runs were hard to comeby. The finish was not what Bangladesh would have wanted. At one stage, it seemed like they would get to over 240 but it is still a very good score.
Two to end and BANGLADESH END WITH 234! A low full toss on middle, this is lofted down towards long on for a couple.

OUT! RUN OUT! Full length, outside off. Ritu Moni slogs it to mid-wicket and calls for a couple. Nida Dar though comes up with an accurate throw to the keeper and Ritu Moni was well short of the crease. Well, to be honest the second run was never there. It was going to be risky.
Another single now! Low full toss, on leg. Khatun lofts it towards long on for one.
Full toss, on middle. Moni pulls it to mid-wicket for one. Can Bangladesh end on a high?
Fuller, angled into the pads. Khatun flicks it through mid on for one.
Two runs now! A full-length ball, on middle and leg. Khatun heaves it across the line to deep mid-wicket for two runs.
Tossed up, full and on off. Moni comes down the track, loft it to long off for a brace.
Full, on off. Khatun sweeps it to mid-wicket for one.
A single, as this is pushed to cover.
Fuller, on off. Salma Khatun tries to sweep it away. It takes the top-edge and flies above the keeper. Sidra Nawaz turns around, gets underneath the ball but fails to gather it. They take one more.
Full length, outside off. Ritu Moni slashes it to cover for one.
Floated, full and on off. Salma Khatun reverse-sweeps it to backward point. The fielder there makes a brilliant stop by diving to her left. They take one.
A single to end then! A full one on middle, Khatun works it down to long on and gets to the other end.
Two more! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for a couple.
Fuller and on off, Ritu pushes it to mid off for one.
Dots are gold at this stage! A yorker on middle, Ritu jams it to the left of the bowler. She wants one but is sent back.
A yorker on middle, this is hit through mid-wicket for one more.
Just the one! Fuller and on middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
Nashra Sandhu misses out on her Hat Trick! Fuller, outside off. Salma Khatun defends it out watchfully. Pakistan have pegged things back really nicely.
Salma Khatun is the new batter.

A huge appeal for lbw but turned down! Bismah Maroof takes another review after yet another loud appeal by the keeper. It is fuller, on the stumps. Fahima Khatun lunges and tries to sweep it away but misses. The ball sneaks under her blade to ping her on the pads. Nashra Sandhu and Sidra Nawaz from behind the sticks appeal. The umpire is unmoved. Pakistan Women take a review. The UltraEdge shows no bat is involved. There is some delay for the Ball Tracker, but eventually it shows three reds and Nashra Sandhu has picked up two wickets in two. The umpire may have given not out as he felt she had hit it but it was batting hitting ground. Sandhu is on a Hat Trick.
Fahima Khatun comes in at number 5.

Tossed up, outside off. It turns away, with some extra bounce off the deck. Fargana Hoque looks to sweep it away from outside off but misses it completely. Although the keeper puts in a loud appeal for caught behind. She has clearly heard something here, but the umpire is unmoved. Sidra Nawaz convinces her skipper to take it upstairs. The UltraEdge confirms there is a spike as the ball crosses the blade. The final decision is OUT. Fargana Hoque goes back to the dugout.
Commentary.Howout: c Sidra Nawaz b Nashra Sandhu

Commentary.Commentary: Floated, full, on middle and leg. Fargana Hoque flicks it through mid-wicket for two runs.
Full, outside off. Moni taps it to point for one.
Fuller, outside off. Hoque comes down the track and tucks it to mid-wicket for one.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Hoque uses her feet to works it past mid on for a single. No boundaries come off this over. Pakistan keeping things tight now.
Swing and a miss! Fuller, wide outside off. Hoque throws her blade at it but misses.
Full, on the stumps. Moni eases it to cover for a quick single.
Anothe single now. Full, on middle and leg. Hoque clears her front leg and works it to mid-wicket. The fielder there fumbles. They take one.
Fuller, wide outside off. Moni comes down the track and slashes it to cover for one.
Full, on off. Hoque eases it to long on for one.
Tossed up, on off. Moni blocks it watchfully. A wicket taking over by Sandhu comes to an end.
Full, on off, pushed to cover.
Ritu Moni is the new batter.

OUT! CAUGHT! Rumana Ahmed's cameo comes to an end. Nashra Sandhu gets her first wicket of the game. It is a loopy delivery, full and on off. Rumana Ahmed drives it uppishly towards mid off but could not get the desired elevation on it. Nida Dar takes a sharp catch above her head.
Commentary.Howout: c Nida Dar b Nashra Sandhu

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller, outside off. Hoque sweeps it through mid-wicket for one.
Full, on the stumps. Hoque defends it into the deck.
Fuller, outside off. Rumana Ahmed whips it across the line to deep square leg. Single taken.

Full, on middle and leg. Hoque works it to mid on. Fatima Sana could not pick it up the first time, but does well on her second attempt. 12 runs off the over. Just what the doctor ordered for Bangladesh.
Full, outside off. Rumana Ahmed eases it to cover and scampers across for a quick single.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Ahmed works it to fine leg off the inside edge. They take two runs. 200 is up for Bangladesh now.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries. This will surely hurt Pakistan Women. Rumana Ahmed picking up her pace right now. Tossed up, full and on off. Rumana Ahmed comes down the track and lofts it past mid off to bag another boundary.
FOUR! Nicely played. A much-needed boundary for Bangladesh Women. Looped up, angled down leg. Rumana Ahmed sweeps it over short fine leg and bags a boundary.
Fuller, on the stumps. Fargana Hoque clears her front leg, whips it across the line past mid on for one.
Fuller, outside off. Ahmed tries to sweep it away but misses. Just 3 runs off it. Nashra Sandhu has done well to keep the run flow in check. Can Bangladesh Women cross the 220-run mark?
Floated, outside off, with some away turn off the deck. Ahmed tries to chase it but misses.
Fuller, outside off. Hoque guides it to backward point for one.
Wide outside off, Ahmed guides it to backward point. The fielder misfields and the batters take one.
Length, outside off. Hoque works it to mid on for one.
Looped up, outside off. Hoque pushes it to mid off.
Full length, on middle and leg. Hoque clips it towards long on for one more. 12 off the last two overs then. Bangladesh Women need some boundaries to end on a high.
Full, outside off. Ahmed drives it to cover. They take one.
Another single, as this is worked towards long on. It is a full toss and Hoque misses out this time around.
An inswinger, angled into the pads. Rumana Ahmed digs it out to mid on for another single.
Length ball, on middle and leg. Hoque flicks it through square leg for one.
Full length, just outside off. Hoque drives it to mid off.
A single to end the over, as this is eased down to long on.
Full length, way outside off. Fargana Hoque shuffles across and sweeps it to deep square leg for a brace. The call was for two and they get two.
Flighted, full, outside off. Rumana Ahmed drives it into covers for one.
Full, outside off. Hoque sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Looped up, full and outside off. Fargana Hoque comes down the track and hits it to mid off. Unable to beat the fielder there.
Full length, outside off. Fargana Hoque outside-edges it towards third man. The batters take two.
End of Powerplay 2! Now, 5 fielders can be placed outside the circle until the end of the innings.
Yorker, right in the blockhole. Rumana Ahmed tucks it to mid-wicket.
Rumana Ahmed is the new batter in.

Fatima Sana serves a length ball, around off, it nips in off the deck. Nigar Sultana stays back and tries to flick it away but ends up playing all around it. Fatima Sana appeals and the umpire raises the dreaded finger. The return of Fatima Sana into the attack prove to be fruitful for Pakistan. Although, Nigar Sultana takes the review. No bat shows the UltraEdge. The Ball Tracking shows it is umpire's call on impact, as the ball goes onto hit the wickets. The onfield decision stands. Fatima Sana breaks a 96-run stand.
An attempted slower one! Ends up as a full toss. Nigar Sultana pulls it to deep mid-wicket for two runs.
Full length, outside off. Nigar Sultana digs it out to point.
An inswinger, full, on off. Nigar Sultana drives it to mid off with soft hands.
Full length, angled into the pads. Nigar Sultana tucks it to mid-wicket. Nida Dar makes a good stop to restrict a single.
Change. Fatima Sana (6-0-33-0) is back into the attack now.
Another single, as this is worked towards cover. Pakistan Women are made to work hard here. The stand moves to 94. Although plenty of batting still to come for Bangladesh.
Fuller, outside off. Fargana Hoque taps it to point with soft hands. The batters are quick enough to complete the run.
Outside off, Hoque works it to point.
Short ball, outside off. Nigar Sultana cuts it to the sweeper cover for one.
Fuller, outside off. Hoque drives it to cover for one more.
Full, on middle and leg. Nigar Sultana flicks it to mid-wicket for one.
An easy single, as this is eased down the ground. The stand moves to 89 now.
On off, pushed to cover.
WIDE! Outside the tramline, outside off. Wide called.
FIFTY FOR HOQUE! Very well played. Short ball, outside off. Fargana Hoque cuts it through covers for one. Fargana Hoque racks up two fifties in last three games.
Full toss, on off. Nigar Sultana whips it across the line to deep square leg for one.
Fuller, outside off. Nigar Sultana lifts it towards wide of long on for a brace.
FOUR! Nigar Sultana getting into the act now. Full and on off. Nigar Sultana comes down the track, lofts it over the bowler's head. A boundary at long on.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Fargana Hoque moves to 49! Looped up, full, angled down leg. Fargana Hoque sweeps it to fine leg for a boundary.
This is really good running! Short ball, outside off. Hoque cuts it past backward point. The batters run two this time with ease.
Floated, around off. Nigar Sultana punches it through point for one.
Fuller, on off. Fargana Hoque sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for one.
A single as this is eased to long on. 150 up for Bangladesh Women.
Short ball, on off. Nigar Sultana pulls it to deep mid-wicket for two.
Short, outside off, Fargana Hoque cuts it hard to cover. Unable to get it through the gap though.
On middle and leg, clipped to mid-wicket.
Flighted, full, outside off. Nigar Sultana drives it to sweeper cover for one.
Flatter, outside off. Hoque bends her knees and cuts it to cover for one.
On middle and leg, defended out.
WIDE! Looped up, wide outside off. It spins away sharply off the deck. Fargana Hoque tries to chase it but misses. Wide called.
Leg spin, short and outside off. Fargana Hoque pulls it hard to short mid-wicket.

DRINKS! Bangladesh Women clearly hold a light advantage in this game. Nigar Sultana and Fargana Hoque are doing the damage to Pakistan. Bangladesh Women have done really well to not lose wickets in regular intervals. Pakistan, on the other hand, have not been on the money so far with the ball. They need to keep things tight and stem up the run flow. An interesting passage of play awaits.
A single as this is pushed to covers.
On off, defended back to the bowler.
Fuller, wide outside off. Nigar Sultana works it to point for a quick single.
Full, outside off. Sultana defends it to point.
On off, Hoque eases it to point for a quick single. The communication between these two batters has been brilliant.
Looped up, outside off. Hoque steps forward to tap it back to the bowler.
This is good running! Fuller, on off. Nigar Sultana sweeps it to deep square leg. The batters take two more.
Nicely played. It is full, outside off. Nigar Sultana comes down the track, lofts it over mid off. The batters take two before the fielder cuts it out at long off.
Floated and full, around off. Nigar Sultana drives it to cover.
Tossed up, on off. Hoque dances down the track and hits it past the bowler for one.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Nigar Sultana sweeps it to deep square leg for one.
Short, on off. Sultana eases it to mid off.
On off, blocked out watchfully.
Short, outside off. Hoque cuts it to cover. No run though.
Sull, outside off. Hoque slashes it to point.
Fuller, on off. Nigar Sultana sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Swing and a miss! Looped up, outside off. Nigar Sultana hangs back and tries to chase it away but misses.
Short, on off. Nigar Sultana slaps it back to the bowler on the back foot. Nida Dar makes a half-stop.
Full, outside off. Nigar Sultana works it to long on for one.
Looped up, full, on off. Nigar Sultana sweeps it to deep square leg for two more. This is really good running.
Touch short, outside off. Nigar Sultana gets it through the gap at point for a brace.
On the stumps, defended out solidly.
Short, outside off. Hoque cuts it to deep point for a single. The stand moves to 50 with this run as well.
On off, blocked to cover.
A single as this is worked towards mid-wicket.
On middle and leg, flicked to mid-wicket.
Length, on off, worked to mid on.

Review! Fargana Hoque takes a review for lbw. The original decision is out. No bat on UltraEdge. The Ball Tracking shows the wickets are missing. Fargana Hoque stays out in the middle. The umpire is forced to overturn the original decision.

NOT OUT! Fatima Sana bowl from wide of the crease. Angled into the pads, on a full length. Fargana Hoque ends up playing all around it and gets pinged on the pads. It looked as if it was going down leg. The umpire though thinks otherwise and raises the dreaded finger. Fargana Hoque reviews instantly and it works in her favour, as the ball is missing the wickets.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries. Fargana Hoque motoring along really well here. Full length, down leg, Fargana Hoque clips it down to fine leg for a boundary.
FOUR! A loosener now. Short ball, on off. Hoque pulls it to fine leg for a boundary.
Fuller, on off. Sultana pushes it to cover. Not in the gap.
Short ball, on off. Sultana tries to cut it away on the back foot. It takes the inside edge and bounces on the deck.
Full, on off. Hoque sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Fuller, angled down leg. Sultana drags her sweep to fine leg for one.
Three wides! Looped up, angling down leg. Nigar Sultana tries to sweep it away but misses. The ball goes past the keeper as well. The batters take a couple, as umpire signals a wide.
On off, blocked out.
A single as this is worked to mid on.

Back of a length, outside off. Nigar Sultana works it to backward point. The fielder makes a sharp stop. She has Nigar Sultana on the floor with an amazing effort at the striker's end. Nigar Sultana could've been back in the pavilion if the stumps were hit.

Short ball, on middle and leg. Fargana Hoque heaves it across the line to deep mid-wicket for one more. Pakistan need to bowl tighter and hunt for wickets. This pair is starting to comfortable at the moment.
Short ball, sliding down leg. Nigar Sultana swivels on her back foot and pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Slower one, full, outside off. Hoque taps it to cover for one.
A single now! These two batters are making sure to keep the runs ticking, Length, on middle and leg. Nigar Sultana clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
WIDE! Length, angled down leg. Sultana fails to flick it away. Wide called.
Full length, outside off. Nigar Sultana drives it past mid off and collects a brace.
Change. Fatima Sana is back into the attack now.
On off, defended out solidly.
FOUR! Nice shot! Tosses it up, full and outside off. Fargana Hoque gets low, picks it up from outside off, sweeps it hard through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Tossed up, on middle. Hoque tucks it to mid-wicket but could not get to the other end.
Flighted, full, on middle and leg. Hoque eases it to mid on.
On leg, blocked out.
Just Short! Short ball, outside off. Nigar Sultana hangs back and cuts it towards point. It lands in front of the fielder. They take one.
Looped up, on off. Hoque defends it back to the bowler.
Touch short, outside off. Nigar Sultana guides it past backward point for a single.
Slower through the air, down leg. Fargana Hoque sweeps it towards fine leg for one.
Full, ou on, Sultana drives it to cover for a single.
On off, pushed to cover for one.
In the air...safe! Looped up, on leg. Fargana Hoque tries to flick it away but mistimes it. The ball flies to the left of the keeper off the leading edge. No trouble.
Fuller, outside off. Nigar Sultana drives it to sweeper cover for a brace.
On off, blocked out solidly.
Short, outside off. Hoque cuts it through covers for a single.
On off, Hoque defends it off the front foot.
Looped up, outside off. Sultana punches it through point for a single.
Full, on the stumps. Sultana tucks to mid-wicket.
On off, pushed to cover.
The sweep comes out. Nigar looks to drag it from outside off, it goes off the top edge towards mid-wicket for one. A decent over for Bangladesh.
Now follows the boundary with a single as this is eased through covers for one.
FOUR! Finds the gap and that is a welcome boundary! Releases a little pressure! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled wide of the fielder at mid on. Deep mid-wicket fives it a chase but in vain.
On off, this is pushed to covers.

That is magical! A ball the great Shane Warne would have been proud of. This is given a lot of flight. It lands around off and then spins away. Draws the batter forward to play a drive. Hoque tries but is beaten.
A single to end the over then! Another good one. Fuller and on middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
Shorter and outside off, this zips through. Hoque looks to cut but is beaten.
Another one on the shorter side, this is once again cut to point.
Shorter and outside off, Hoque guides it to point.
On off, this is pushed to mid off.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for one.
Outside off, Sultana plays it through covers for one.
Outside off, slower, left alone.
On middle, blocked.
Down the leg side, Sultana looks to sweep but it hits the glove and then the keeper's pad.
BEATEN! This lands around off and turns away. Sultana looks to defend but is beaten.
Loopy ball on middle, kept out.
Shorter and on off, Hoque guides it to point.
Tossed up on off, defended.
Outside off, this is eased through covers for one.
Good stop! On off, this is played to the right of the bowler who dives and saves one.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Misses out! That is very short and outside off, this is cut but to point.
Another single to end! ON off, Hoque strokes it to covers again.
A little too short, Sultana plays it to covers for one.
Shorter in length and outside off, NIgar cuts but to point.
Shorter and on off, this is pushed to covers.
Uppish but in the gap! On off, tossed up. Hoque looks to drive but this one turns away, it goes more off the outer half through point for one.
On middle, defended.
Outside off, shorter. Sultana looks to cut but is beaten.
On middle, Sultana blocks.
Another one floated up on off, this is pushed to mid off.
Outside off, left alone.
Tossed up on off, defended.
Nigar Sultana is the new batter in.

OUT! TIMBER! There is the big wicket, there is the wicket Pakistan wanted. Sharmin Akhter falls 6 short of a half ton. She can consider herself a tad unlucky here. This is tossed up, it is down the leg side though. Akhtar looks to sweep but is a touch early in the shot. It hits the glove and then rolls onto the stumps. Can this be the opening Pakistan wanted?
Outside off, left alone.
Another one tossed up and on middle, Hoque blocks it well.
Gives it a lot of air and lands it on off, blocked.
On middle, this is swept through fine leg for one.
Shorter and on off, Hoque pushes it through covers for one.
WIDE! A lot of turn there! This lands outside off and spins away. Hoque looks to cut but then lets it be. Wided.
Lands it well! Tossed up on off, defended.
Change! Ghulam Fatima comes on now.
Flatter and outside off, Akhter looks to guide it down to third man but is beaten.
On middle, blocked.
BEATEN! Tossed up outside off again, Akhter goes for the drive again but is beaten.
FOUR! That has been hit so hard! What a shot. Fuller and outside off, this is thumped through covers. It races away to the fence.
On middle, this is pushed back towards the bowler.
Shorter and outside off, this is pushed through covers for one.

DRINKS! Bangladesh are in a great position here! They began so well in the Powerplay, things have slowed down a bit but still are in a superb position. Pakistan on the other hand, need a couple of wickets quickly or they will fall well behind in the game. An important passage awaits after the break.
On middle, this is worked through square leg for one.
BEATEN! This lands outside off and holds its line. Hoque defends inside the line and is beaten.
Flighted ball on middle, this is pushed back to the bowler.
A little too short, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.
Fuller and on middle, this is hit through mid on for one.
An appeal from Dar but she is the only one doing so! On the pads, fuller, Akhter sweeps it towards fine leg for one.
Gives it air and lands it on off, Hoque pushes it to covers. Another dot and the spinners have applied the brakes on the run flow here.
Slower through the air and on middle, kept out.
Another dot! Shorter and on off, this is cut but to point.
Fuller and on off, this is driven to covers.
Angled into the pads, this is flicked through square leg for one.
On off, Akhter blocks.
A dot to end! On off, this is pushed to cover.
A little too short, this is pulled down to long on for one.
On middle, this is flicked to mid-wicket.
Fuller and on off, this is played back to the bowler.
Outside off, this is pushed through covers for one.
That is really well fielded! This is full and on off, it is smashed to cover who makes a half stop. No run.
On middle, Hoque flicks it to mid-wicket.
Another flighted ball on off, Hoque pushes it to covers again.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed to covers.
Tossed up on off, Hoque pushes it to covers.
On middle, this is worked through square leg for one.
Outside off, this is pushed through covers for one.
FOUR! Nice and fine! Once again all the pressure that was building has been released! Down the leg side. Akhter sweeps it nice and fine for a boundary.
Fuller and on middle, this is played back to the bowler.
Another dot! Outside off, flatter. Akhter guides it to point. She wants a run but is rightly sent back.
Make that 9! Fuller and on middle, this is pushed back to the bowler.
On the pads, Akhter flicks it to square leg. 8 dots in a row.
On middle, Akhter works it to mid-wicket.
Another dot to end! So after conceding a five wides, 6 dots after that. On off, this is kept out.
On the stumps, kept out.
Another one tossed up on middle, Hoque pushes it to mid on.
On middle, kept out again.
Shorter and outside off, Hoque looks to cut but is beaten.
On middle, defended.
FIVE WIDES! Down the leg side. Fargana leaves it alone. The keeper does not collect it and it goes down to the fence for a boundary.
Another dot to end! On the stumps, it is worked to square leg.
On middle, this is defended.
A very full ball on middle, Akhter works it to mid-wicket.
Shorter and outside off, this zips through. Akhter looks to cut but is beaten.
On middle, this is worked to square leg for one.
Fuller and on middle, this is played back to the bowler.
Powerplay 2! Now 4 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 40th over.
FOUR! Tickled fine! 50 up for Bangladesh and it is the perfect start to the game for them. They are 51 for 1 after 10. On middle, this is worked fine on the leg side and it races away to the fence.
Two more! Shorter and on middle, Akhtar pulls it hard through mid-wicket for two.
Fuller and on off, Akhter pushes it to covers. It is yet another no ball. Diana Baig has overstepped again.
Just the single from the Free Hit! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled hard through square leg for one.
BEATEN! Length and outside off, Hoque looks to push at it but is beaten. Dar has overstepped, it is a no ball and now a Free Hit for Hoque.
Good batting! Now follows the boundary with a single as this is worked through square leg.
EDGY FOUR! Bangladesh won't care how they come as long as they do. Shorter and outside off, Akhter looks to cut, it goes off the outside edge past the keeper and down to the third man fence.
Half an appeal but going down leg! On the pads, Akhter looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
BEATEN! A lovely nut to end a brilliant over by Dar! Flatter and outside off, Hoque looks to defend, she plays for the turn but is beaten.
Fargana Hoque walks out to bat!

OUT! TAKEN! That is a brilliant catch by Fatima Sana! Shamima Sultana can't believe that she has to walk back! She hit that so hard. It is full and on middle, this is whipped towards wide mid on. It is going at a rapid pace. Sana takes it nicely. Much-needed wicket for Pakistan. Can they now take control of this game?
Commentary.Howout: c Fatima Sana b Nida Dar

Commentary.Commentary: Floats it up on middle, Sultana plays it back to the bowler.
Tossed up on off, this is driven to covers.
On middle, Akhter works it to square leg and takes one.
She gets away with one there! Shoter and outside off, Akhter looks to cut but finds point.
Nida Dar comes on now!
A single to end! Bangladesh going along really well. On middle, this is worked around the corner for one.
Length and on off, Akhtar defends it again.
On the stumps yet again, it is kept out.
Good length and on off, blocked.
WIDE! Down the leg side. Akhter looks to flick but misses. Wided.
FOUR! Creamed! What a shot again. Delightful! Full and on off, this is driven wonderfully through covers and into the fence.
Fuller and on middle, this is worked to square leg.
So, just the boundary from the over then! On middle, defended.

Another chance goes by! Not the best of throws but that should have been collected by the bowler. On the pads, Sultana looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. It goes behind towards the keeper. The non-striker is off, she is halfway down the wicket but then is sent back. The keeper throws it a little too high for the bowler who looks to collect but takes her eyes off the ball at the very end, it bursts through and goes behind. Pakistan had to take that. They are under pressure here.
FOUR! That has been hammered! What a shot that is. Not such a bad delivery. Length and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for a boundary.
Angled into middle, Sultana works it to mid-wicket.
Yet another delivery on a length and on off, kept out.
Good length and on off, blocked.
A dot to end a productive over for Bangladesh! On middle, this is worked to mid on.
Outside off, Sultana guides it down to third man and takes one.
Good length and on middle, Sultana keeps it out nicely.
Three more! This is a really good start for Bangladesh! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket. Three taken.
Good length and on off, defended.
Two more! Shorter and on off, Akhter pushes it through covers. Two taken. Really good running. Lovely shot too. Good from the batter.
A dot to end! Outside off, shorter. Sultana looks to cut but misses.
FOUR! Stand and deliver! Lovely shot. Shorter and on middle, fractionally short actually. Sultana stands tall and pulls it through mid-wicket. This one races away to the fence.
Good fielding! Good call too! Length and on off, this is guided to the right of point. The striker wants one but the non-striker sends her back.

Well bowled! But not sure if you need to play at that. Maybe the angle, the wide of the crease angle makes the batter play. It angles into off and then shapes away. Sultana pokes at it away from the body and is beaten.
Another one on a length and around off, blocked.
Sana bowls this from wide of the crease and on off, it is blocked.
A quick run to end and this is a good over for the batting side! On middle, Sultana works it towards square leg and gets to the other end.
On middle, Akhter works it down to fine leg and gets to the other end.
Fuller and on off, Akhter pushes it to covers.
On middle, length, it is worked to mid-wicket.

FOUR! That is very sloppy, very, very sloopy! Ghulam Fatima was the fielder! On the pads, this is worked through square leg. The fielder in the deep makes a lot of ground to her left, she ends up trying to stop it with her leg but it sneaks under and goes behind to the fence. Not sure why she did not bend down there. Baig is not happy and rightly so. That boundary releases the pressure that was building.
Back of a length, on the shorter side, Akhter stands tall and guides it to point.
A lot better second over then from Sana! Just the one from it. On off, Sultana guides it to point.
Fuller and on off, Sultana pushes it to covers.
Just wide! Length and around off, Akhter opens the face of the bat at the very end, it goes just wide of the fielder at widish first slip and down to third man for one.
Right there! Length and on off, Akhter pushes it to mid off.

That seemed like the effort ball. It is shortish and outside off, takes off after landing. Akhter does look to cut but then sees the extra bounce and lets it be. Fatima has been a little too short so far. Needs to get it fuller.
Nicely timed but the gap is not found! Shorter and on off, Akhter pushes it off the back foot but to coves.
She indeed can! Length and on off, Sultana leans forward and guides it to point. Good accurate stuff from Diana Baig!
Really full and on middle, once again a little bit of shape away. Sultana plays it back towards the bowler. Can she end the over well now?
Another appeal! Maybe too high! Slightly shorter and on middle, Shamima Sultana looks to pull, this does not bounce as much as she expected it to. It hits her on the thigh.
Fuller and on middle, Sultana pushes it to mid on.
On off, length, defended to covers.
Half an appeal but that is probably going down leg. On the pads, Akhtar looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad and rolls towards fine leg. A run taken. Leg bye.
Diana Baig to bowl from the other end!
A good nut to end but a good first over for Bangladesh. Good length and on off, this lands and moves away. Sultana looks to defend but is beaten.
FOUR! Creamed! That is a wonderful shot for the first boundary! Right in the slot. Full and outside off, it is caressed through covers.

Run out chance goes abegging and then an overthrow! Length and on off, this is guided towards cover. The batters initially take off but then stop, eventually they go for the single. The fielder picks it up and she throws it at the wrong end, the keeper's end who does not collect it on the first attempt. She then picks it up and has a needless shy at the bowler's end but misses. The fielder backing up makes a half stop. Another run taken.
Some movement for Sana! Outside off, shapes away. Left alone.
Sharmin is also underway now! Angled into the pads, this is worked towards square leg for a quick run.
Bangladesh and Sultana are underway! Length and around off, this is guided down to third man for one.

Done and dusted with the anthems and now it is time for the game to begin! The Pakistan players make their way out to the middle and they are followed by the Bangladesh openers, Shamima Sultana and Sharmin Akhter. Fatima Sana has the first new ball in hand. Here we go...
Time for the Anthems! It is Bangladesh who will sing their first and then it will be Pakistan's turn.
BANGLADESH (PLAYING XI) - Shamima Sultana (WK), Murshida Khatun, Fargana Hoque, Nigar Sultana (C), Rumana Ahmed, Ritu Moni, Salma Khatun, Suraiya Azmin, Jahanara Alam, Shanjida Akter, Fariha Trisna.
PAKISTAN (PLAYING XI) - Nahida Khan, Sidra Ameen, Bismah Maroof (C), Omaima Sohail, Nida Dar, Aliya Riaz, Fatima Sana, Sidra Nawaz (WK), Diana Baig, Nashra Sandhu, Ghulam Fatima.

Nigar Sultana says they now need to put up a good score on the board which will be difficult to chase. Reckons this is a good wicket and they wanted to bat, they have done well in the last few games and they want to put in a good performance here. Informs they have two changes.

Bismah Maroof says they want to take early wickets and bowl them out quickly. Adds they do have positives from the last game and are looking forward to this game. informs they are playing the same game.
TOSS - Up goes the coin and it lands in the favor of Pakistan! THEY WILL BOWL FIRST!

The batting has probably been the problem for both the sides! The bowling has fared decently but the batting has not been upto the mark. Pakistan though did show signs of improvement in the last game. They fought hard in the last game against a strong South African side and that game must have given them a lot of confidence. They can be considered favorites in this game but we recently saw them being beaten by Bangladesh who surely can't be ruled out. Toss and teams in a bit.

Two sides at the bottom of the table will battle it out in the 12th game of this year's Womens World Cup. It is Bangladesh against Pakistan. Both sides are still to win a game in this tournament. Pakistan have played three and lost three, Bangladesh on the other hand, have lost both the games they have played. Both will be rearing to go and will back themselves to come out on top here. It is a very important clash for both. Who will bag their first win?
... MATCHDAY ...
